Use pytest for testing Python code.

Never use camel-case for naming. Use snake_case instead.  In Python, use PascalCase for class names.

Constants should be in all caps.

Python functions that are not used outside of a module should be prefixed with an underscore.

Always add a docstring to Python functions you generate.

Don't add a return type to Python functions unless necessary.

When generating tests, use the Arrange, Act, Assert pattern when possible.
